claim_definition: The verifier MUST detect when a script is corrupted by a bit-flip (a single character changed in the script text) and reject the corrupted input. This proves the verifier validates input integrity, not just execution.

test_cases.description: Mutation test: changes evolve(2) to evolve(3) in the valid TC-001 script. The verifier MUST detect that the mutated script produces a different computation path and report failure.
